name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just token cost—it’s that Sonnet 3.7’s 0.7% gain is measured on static benchmarks, not EXCAVA’s live drift. A 48-hour A/B test proves nothing if the model updates weekly; run a 30-day rolling accuracy check against Haiku’s current baseline—if drift erases the gain, the switch fails.
